When the equipper receives a lethal hit for the first time all buffs and debuffs will be removed, HP restored to 100% and become frozen for 1 turn. While frozen, defense is increased by 100% and they become immune to debuffs. If the equipper survives the frozen status, HP is restored to 100% again.
Only triggers once per battle.
location: Soul Zones · Fallen Sun · Mystery Soul Shop · Mystic Trader
